description: This file contains a static helper class 'GeometryHelper' within the PdfSharp.Drawing namespace, providing methods to generate geometric path segments, convert arcs to Bézier curves, and other geometric computations used in PDF graphics rendering, especially tailored for different frameworks like WPF, WUI, GDI, or WPF-like environments.

classes.name: GeometryHelper
classes.description: A static helper class providing methods for constructing geometric path segments, especially arcs and Bézier curves, for PDF graphics rendering.

methods.name: CreateCurveSegment
methods.description: Creates a Bézier segment from a curve with given points and tension, tailored for WPF or WUI environments.

methods.name: CreatePolygonGeometry
methods.description: Creates a PathGeometry representing a polygon from an array of points, with specified fill mode and closed/ open path.

methods.name: CreatePolyLineSegment
methods.description: Creates a PolyLineSegment from an array of points, used in WPF or WUI to represent polylines.

methods.name: CreateArcSegment
methods.description: Creates an ArcSegment representing an elliptical arc from parameters similar to GDI+ arc function, providing the start point for the segment.

methods.name: BezierCurveFromArc
methods.description: Computes a series of Bézier points approximating an elliptic arc defined by position, size, angles, and sweep flags.

methods.name: BezierCurveFromArc
methods.description: Computes a series of Bézier points approximating an arc defined in WPF-like parameters between two points and size, with rotation and flags.

methods.name: ArcToBezier
methods.description: Converts an elliptical SVG-like arc into Bézier curve segments, returning points and the number of segments; includes handling for degenerate cases.

methods.name: GetArcAngle
methods.description: Calculates the number of Bézier segments needed to approximate an arc and the sine/cosine of each segment's sweep angle.

methods.name: GetBezierDistance
methods.description: Computes the relative distance from arc endpoints to Bézier control points for arc approximation.

methods.name: AcceptRadius
methods.description: Determines if a radius is large enough relative to chord length, given a fuzz factor.
